BL-870 — DEFECT — the daemon wakes a role without recording what for, so a false 'new handoff mail' wake has now recurred twice and been undiagnosable both times
What it solves: Severity high on the "broken safety or health signal" limb rather than on
impact: no data is lost, but a wake that fires falsely and cannot be
explained trains both agents and the operator to discount the signal, and
discounting it is how a genuine wake gets missed. It has now fired falsely
twice i…
Approval context: One judgement call, and it is the whole ticket: this slice does not fix the false wake. It makes the next one diagnosable.
I could not root-cause it from the available evidence, and I would rather say so than ship a guess. Two candidate causes were probed and ELIMINATED. The coordinator's `in_proce…
